name: 長嘴鴴
illustrationTaxon: Thinornis placidus adult male: like a large, long-billed, long-legged Little Ringed Plover, 18-21 cm; obviously larger with longer bill, legs and wings; ear coverts and lores always brown; adults usually have a broad black band above the white forehead, which appears during moult in the first winter; obvious whitish inner wing bar in flight; tail white-tipped with a black subterminal band; first-winter birds have obvious pale fringes to the upperparts and wing coverts, no black on the head and dull legs. Monotypic.

similarSpecies.distinction: 體型較小、嘴短而基部橙色、眼先及耳羽深黑、腳橙色、胸前黑帶闊而深黑；本種較大、嘴長而全黑、眼先及耳羽褐色、腳淡黃、胸帶褐色較窄。
體型較小、嘴短、腳較短、有明顯黃色眼圈、翼短於尾、胸前黑帶較窄而深；本種明顯較大、嘴長腳長翼長、無黃眼圈、胸帶褐色、後端明顯拉長。

featureNotes: 嘴明顯長而纖細、全黑，比金眶鴴及劍鴴都長，是第一個結構特徵（第1圈取自頭部特寫，實際可見）。
眼先與耳羽永遠是褐色而非黑色，配白色眉線與白頰；上方還有一道寬黑帶橫過前額（第2圈取自頭部特寫，實際可見，成鳥才有這道黑帶）。
胸前帶較窄且偏褐灰，白喉與白腹之間只有一條窄帶，帶的上下都是白色；劍鴴的黑帶則闊而深黑（第3圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
腳長而淡黃，脛跗明顯比金眶鴴長，站在河灘卵石上（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

sources.use: HKBWS substantive identification/range/conservation read: Category I rare winter visitor; 18-21cm; compared to Little Ringed Plover obviously larger with longer bill, legs and wings; ear coverts and lores always brown; adults usually have a broad black band above the white forehead which appears during moult in the first winter; whitish inner wing bar in flight obvious; tail white-tipped with a black subterminal band; first-winter birds have pale fringes to the upperparts and wing coverts, no black on the head and dull legs; recorded in both brackish and freshwater habitat including freshwater marsh, tidal river channel and drained fish pond; records 5 December to 20 March (1994 Kam Tin 20 Feb-20 Mar, 1998 Pak Nai 30 Jan, 1999 near Mai Po village 5 Dec, 2014 Kam Sheung Road 9 Jan-23 Feb, 2015 Lok Ma Chau 4-27 Feb); monotypic, breeds in Ussuriland, northeast and central northern China and Japan, winters in South Korea and south China west to Nepal and southeast to northern Indochina; IUCN Least Concern with a decreasing trend.
HKBWS Common Ringed Plover comparison: smaller with a shorter bill with an orange base, dark lores and ear coverts, orange legs, broader blacker breast band.
HKBWS Little Ringed Plover comparison: smaller, shorter bill and legs, obvious yellow orbital ring, shorter wings, narrower blacker breast band.
